limitation: Exploratory observational contrast, not an identified causal effect or pitch-selection policy. Coach intent, hitter quality, health and other unmeasured confounders remain. Global target, identity and density preparation is transductive. Density is reconstructed from whole-game observations and is not a verified prospectively available pre-pitch measurement. Bootstrap intervals describe held-out pitcher composition conditional on one fitted forest, not model/causal uncertainty. Current-pitch movement, location, outcome and derived scores are excluded from covariates.
effect_direction: negative means lower modelled xRV for breaking balls
preparation: global target/identity/density on selected whole games
